issues.description: take_next compensates for a no-op move_forward with one-byte increments, so absent page-table regions are traversed at unaligned byte addresses instead of advancing to the next PTE.
issues.rationale: At the selected problem snapshot, move_forward has no executable statements and ensures va is unchanged. take_next then adds one byte after the absent-entry call, adds one byte after the empty-child call, and adds a third unconditional byte in the partial-entry path. Starting from a page-aligned absent entry, subsequent iterations use unaligned addresses and may scan a page byte by byte. Repair 8499a981 computes align_down(va,page_size)+page_size, guarantees strict progress, and removes all three compensating increments.
